disambiguation: Not a general note formatting tool; it specifically frames daily notes in preview mode.
intentEvidence: Dayframe is an Obsidian plugin that adds a customizable "frame" (prefix and suffix content) around your daily notes when viewed in preview mode.
motivation: Inspired by the desire to simplify my daily notes.
problem: It addresses the need to keep raw daily note markdown files clean while still providing rich, contextual information in the reading view.

relations.evidence: Ensure you have the BRAT plugin installed and enabled.
On the first run, obsidian-dev-utils also downloads the Hot Reload plugin into the test vault.

summary: Dayframe adds a customizable frame (prefix and suffix content) around daily notes when viewed in preview mode, keeping raw markdown files clean.
